# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b25 - Single canonical integration

Beta25 makes `environment_manager` the **only active and installable Home Assistant integration domain**.

## One integration only

The runtime no longer registers any service, frontend path, config-flow domain or installable integration under:

- `air_quality_advisor`
- `enviroment_manager`
- `home_environment_manager`

All user-facing Home Assistant actions now use only:

- `environment_manager.announce`
- `environment_manager.pid_control`
- `environment_manager.climate_control`
- `environment_manager.climate_diagnostics`

Historical domain names remain only inside migration code so an existing installation can be imported once without losing identity.

## Duplicate old folders are retired automatically

A previous HACS/domain migration may leave an old custom-component directory such as:

- `/config/custom_components/air_quality_advisor`
- `/config/custom_components/enviroment_manager`

When the canonical `environment_manager` integration loads, beta25 verifies the legacy folder's own `manifest.json` really belongs to that historical domain. Only then it moves the folder out of `custom_components` into:

`/config/.environment_manager_legacy_components/`

The old files are preserved as backup instead of deleted. Home Assistant's custom-component discovery cache is then refreshed so the old package no longer appears as another integration to install.

Unrelated custom components are never touched.

## Existing configuration is preserved

Legacy config entries are still accepted as migration inputs. The existing entry is re-homed to `environment_manager` in place while preserving:

- exact config-entry ID;
- room subentry IDs;
- entity IDs and unique IDs;
- device IDs;
- custom names and disabled states;
- options and stored controller/history data.

The historical names are not retained as runtime aliases after migration.

## HACS packaging

Beta25 keeps the flat-tag HACS layout introduced for beta24. The release tag itself contains only the canonical integration payload at repository root, with `content_in_root: true`. There is no second integration package inside the tag.

## Validation

Publication is gated on:

- Python 3.13 and 3.14 full regression suites;
- a static contract that rejects legacy runtime aliases;
- a Home Assistant 2026.10 filesystem test that creates both legacy component folders, verifies they leave `custom_components`, verifies backups remain recoverable, and confirms an unrelated component is untouched;
- exact config-entry-ID migration tests from both historical domains;
- HACS validation;
- Hassfest;
- flat HACS tag-archive extraction simulation;
- Hassfest against the exact flattened payload.

This remains an opt-in beta. Stable Latest remains v0.5.1.
